05 / BEFORE WE BEGIN

A few things
worth knowing.

A little preparation makes the first conversation more useful.

Ask us on Zalo
01What do I need for a quotation?＋

Share the product, dimensions, weight, estimated quantity and reference images. Include your artwork if available so HotPrint can discuss a suitable approach and provide an individual quotation.

02Do you need a physical product to make a carton sample?＋

Length, width and height are a starting point. For unusual shapes or internal support requirements, discuss sending the actual product to check the fit and opening experience.

03Where do I start without finished artwork?＋

Share your logo, print content, colour direction and references. HotPrint will discuss the design scope and any information needed before work begins.

04Can I request a sample first?＋

Use the sample request on this page. Reference samples, structural samples and printed samples are discussed individually; conditions, costs and timing are agreed directly.

05What are the minimum quantity and production time?＋

These depend on the structure, materials, finishing and order quantity. HotPrint confirms them after reviewing your brief; no single requirement applies to every sample.

06Can a reference design be adapted?＋

The photographs show existing samples from HotPrint’s library. Ask about adapting the size and presentation to your own product and identity; structure and artwork are agreed before production.
